text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory slipped away from Matikane 
Tannhauser. And for Mihono Bourbon, who 
was aiming for the Triple Crown, it meant 
watching her dream shatter as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Classic Triple Crown campaign 
is far from over. Next up is the "Japanese 
Derby."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Slurping down some ramen... they fired 
themselves back up for the upcoming 
Japanese Derby!
